title: Beacon Ridge Solar Share Sign-Up Credit: Training Notes
content:
**Rule.** A Community Solar Subscriptions plan with a sign-up credit above $0.00 earns one sign-up credit once the subscription's billed cycles reach the plan's cycle count for the sign-up credit. The solar sign-up credit is posted only once per subscription. Credits are posted as their own lines and do not reduce a cancellation fee.

**What counts as a billed cycle?**
A subscription fee line on the subscription, counted from the allocation date up to the handling date.

**When is the credit earned?**
When the count of those subscription fee lines reaches the plan's cycle count. With a hypothetical cycle count of 2: after 1 billed cycle the count has not yet reached 2; after the second subscription fee line it has.

**How is "only once" judged?**
From the system record: a sign-up credit line already posted on that subscription means the subscription has had its sign-up credit.

**Does a sign-up credit reduce a cancellation fee?**
No. The credit is posted as its own line. With a hypothetical cancellation fee of $150.00 and a hypothetical sign-up credit of $50.00, the cancellation fee line stays $150.00 and the sign-up credit stands as a separate $50.00 credit line.

**What is the effect of the credit on the account?**
A sign-up credit reduces the net amount Beacon Ridge has invoiced the subscriber.

## Quick judgement (hypothetical plan with a sign-up credit and a cycle count of 2)

| Subscription fee lines since allocation | Sign-up credit line already on the subscription | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | No | Count not yet reached |
| 2 | No | Earned |
| 3 | No | Earned |
| 3 | Yes | Already posted once; no second sign-up credit |
